business_scope.primary_industry_name: AI Video Synthesis and Virtual Avatar Generation Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law system with Islamic Sharia constitutional overlay (Article 2 of the 2014 Constitution); Unitary national legal framework; no sub-state tax distinctions
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt–United Kingdom Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (1976)
Egypt–United Kingdom Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (1980)
Egypt–Turkey Free Trade Agreement (signed 2005; in force 2007)
Agadir Agreement — Arab-Mediterranean Free Trade Area (2004)
COMESA Treaty — Egypt as a member state

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Statutory UBO, AML, and CFT pyramid for Egypt: (i) Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2015 and subsequent amendments; (ii) Executive Regulations of Law No. 80 of 2002 issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 95 of 2003, as amended; (iii) Unified Companies Law No. 4 of 2022, imposing beneficial-owner identification and record-keeping obligations on limited liability companies filing with GAFI; (iv) GAFI executive instructions on UBO identification applied to corporate service providers and incorporation portals; (v) EMLCU (Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit) rules and Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) AML/CFT regulations binding on the banking channel that will open the LLC's operating account; (vi) FATF Recommendations transposed into EMLCU examination practice; and (vii) Counter-Terrorism Law No. 94 of 2015, as amended.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (equivalent) and Certificate of Good Standing of every non-Egyptian corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the jurisdiction of origin (e.g., Companies House, Delaware Division of Corporations equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Egypt became a Contracting State effective 14 December 2021); for non-Apostille jurisdictions, consular legalization via the Egyptian Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the Egyptian incorporation attorney and first manager/signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where applicable; otherwise Egyptian consular legalization, plus a certified Arabic translation for filing with GAFI

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Individual UBO KYC packet: notarized passport copy, proof of address, and signed UBO declaration for each natural person holding 25% or more
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the beneficial owner's country of residence

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2009 and Law No. 94 of 2015), Articles 23-32 (Limited Liability Companies); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2310 of 2017); Implementation Regulations of the Companies Law (Ministerial Decree No. 96 of 1982).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Investors' Service Center (One-Stop Shop), in coordination with the Commercial Registry Department of the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum of Association / Articles of Association ('Aqd Al-Ta'sis' / 'Al-Nizam Al-Asasi') executed before a licensed Notary Public, together with the GAFI Incorporation Application Form leading to issuance of the Single Approval Notice.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to Egyptian LLCs (minimum_capital_requirement: false); however, the full declared capital must be subscribed and the cash portion deposited into a temporary escrow bank account maintained with a licensed Egyptian bank before incorporation certificate issuance (a bank certificate must be attached to the filing). In-kind contributions require a sworn valuation report.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF EG LLC. RESOLVED, THAT: (1) the entire allotted share capital declared in the Memorandum of Association is hereby subscribed, and the Managing Director shall deposit the initial contributions into the company's temporary escrow bank account at a licensed Egyptian bank; (2) the registered office shall be established at the address notified to GAFI, Cairo, Egypt; (3) [Name] is appointed Managing Director and [Name] is appointed Chief Financial Officer with joint authority over banking, tax, and administrative matters; (4) the officers are jointly authorized to execute the GAFI incorporation application, notarized documents, commercial registry entry, tax registration, social insurance enrolment, and all operational permits; and (5) this resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop and Online Portal (www.gafi.gov.eg) - Company Name Reservation Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Perform an online and physical availability search against the GAFI and Commercial Registry name database; submit a name reservation application in Arabic with the English transliteration ending in 'LLC'; pay the name reservation administrative fee; collect the provisional name reservation certificate valid for 60 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Name search and reservation application form (GAFI standard form)
Certified passport copies of all founding shareholders
Signed authorization letter in favor of the local formation agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resubmit an amended request with two to three alternative names; if the chosen name is rejected on public-policy or trademark grounds, file a written complaint with the GAFI Name Committee review board within 30 days, attaching trademark clearance searches.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution and Notarization of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Notary Public Chambers (Ministry of Justice - Real Estate Publicity and Notarization Authority) or the GAFI Legal Counsel Chamber
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint Egyptian legal counsel to draft the Arabic Articles of Association covering the corporate purpose (AI software development, virtual avatar video generation and SaaS), capital schedule, profit and loss sharing ratios, board composition, quorum and dispute resolution; convene all founders or their attorney-in-fact before the notary; sign every page after reading; obtain the notarization stamp of the Al-Shahr Al-Aqari for onward filing.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association in Arabic (English translation for internal records)
GAFI provisional name reservation certificate
Passport copies and specimen signatures of founders
Bank escrow deposit certificate or sworn in-kind valuation report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses execution due to drafting defects, rectify the Articles and re-execute before the same notary; record the rectification in a supplemental notarial deed within the name reservation validity period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Filing with GAFI One-Stop Shop and Issuance of the Single Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Investors' Service Center (One-Stop Shop, Cairo headquarters or governorate branch)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation dossier at the One-Stop Shop window or digitally via the GAFI licensing platform; GAFI verifies the notarized Articles, name certificate, capital deposit certificate and founder identity documents; pay the official registration and certificate issuance fees; collect the Single Approval ('Al-Muwafaqa Al-Wahida') comprising the incorporation certificate and authorizing downstream commercial, tax and social insurance registrations.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association (original plus two certified copies)
Valid name reservation certificate
Passport copies and legal addresses of all founders and managers
Bank certificate evidencing deposit of declared cash capital (or valuation report for in-kind contributions)
GAFI incorporation application signed by all founders
Schedule of managers with criminal record declarations
Lease contract or title deed of the prospective registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any GAFI request for information within 10 working days; in case of refusal, lodge an administrative grievance with the GAFI internal examination committee under Article 77 of Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, with a decision expected within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Entry and Company Data Publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office (Al-Sijil Al-Tijari) - governorate office / GAFI One-Stop Shop integrated window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Single Approval and notarized Articles to the Commercial Registry desk; complete the registration form identifying managers, authorized signatures and the corporate object; pay registration and publication fees; obtain the commercial registry certificate required for bank account opening, contracting and subsequent licensing.
required_dossiers: GAFI Single Approval Notice
Notarized Articles of Association
Registered office lease contract or title deed
Criminal record certificates ('Kayd Al-Hasan') of managers
Tax card copy of the lessor (if the landlord is a commercial entity)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a rectification request with the registry supervisor for any data entry errors; escalate after 10 working days through the GAFI One-Stop Shop complaint desk, attaching the Single Approval as conclusive proof.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Tax Card Issuance and E-Invoicing Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Tax Card and Registration Administration (district office competent for the registered address)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the registration file to the ETA district office; obtain the Tax Card covering income tax and VAT regimes; activate the ETA e-Invoicing and e-Receipt system by onboarding to the ETA portal with an electronic signature and integration of the billing system as required under Law No. 67 of 2016; register as an employer for withholding tax purposes.
required_dossiers: Commercial registry certificate
GAFI Single Approval
Notarized Articles of Association
Manager IDs and specimen signatures
Office lease contract and electricity bill as address proof
Bank account opening certificate
Company seal specimen
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Tax Card application is queried or suspended, submit the requested clarifications in writing (address proof or capital evidence); escalate to the ETA district director after 10 working days; appeal wrongful refusal under Article 130 of Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance and Employer File Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NIO) - regional social insurance office / GAFI One-Stop Shop social insurance window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the corporate social insurance file on the NIO digital portal or in person; enroll the entity as an employer and register each founding employee and manager in the Egyptian Social Insurance system under Law No. 79 of 1975, as amended; obtain the employer registration number before the first payroll disbursement.
required_dossiers: Commercial registry certificate
Tax card certificate
Manager IDs and authorized signatory power of attorney
List of founding employees with national ID copies
Office lease contract and payroll structure
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Submit a manual correction application to the NIO office if employee enrolment is rejected; pay any assessed contributions under explicit protest to preserve objection rights; file an appeal with the NIO grievance committee within 60 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No factory or industrial license applies to the AI video synthesis SaaS activity; the Industrial Development Authority (IDA) retains oversight of regulated manufacturing, while the GAFI One-Stop Shop is the competent licensing authority for the general operating permit, in coordination with the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT) for software sector accreditation.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: GAFI Single Approval Notice (General Operating License under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017), read together with the Civil Defense Operating License (Law No. 44 of 2016) and the Egyptian Tax Authority e-Invoicing Activation Certificate.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Environmental Licensing and Monitoring Directorate
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - Exempt from full Environmental Impact Assessment under Ministerial Decree No. 964 of 2015 for office-based software and digital services; the entity remains subject to a self-assessment environmental register filing and general operator duties under Law No. 4 of 1994, as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process discharges: domestic sanitary wastewater must comply with Municipal Sewer Law No. 93 of 1962 discharge limits into public networks; no VOC or particulate air emissions from premises; obsolete servers, GPUs and electronic waste must be surrendered to EEAA-licensed recyclers under Law No. 4 of 1994; server-room noise and thermal outputs must comply with EEAA ambient noise limits for commercial districts and EOS energy efficiency standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Fire Safety Certificate under Law No. 44 of 2016 from the local Civil Defense Administration - fire extinguishers, emergency exits, alarm and smoke detection systems in the registered office; structural load inspection by the local municipal engineer for the leased premises; occupational safety and health clearance under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 (Articles 213-228) and Ministerial Decree No. 211 of 2003 covering first aid, ventilation, emergency lighting, ergonomic IT workstations and safe use of electrical equipment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance — official portals: incometax.gov.eg (TIN/income tax registration), eta.gov.eg and einvoicing.eta.gov.eg (VAT registration, e-invoicing clearance and tax card services)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC obtains its statutory TIN and VAT ID by: (1) completing incorporation and commercial registration at the GAFI-affiliated Commercial Registry; (2) submitting registration Form 1 under the Executive Regulations of Income Tax Law No. 91/2005 and VAT Law No. 67/2016 to the ETA through the online tax portal (incometax.gov.eg or ETA e-services), attaching certified Arabic articles of association, commercial registration certificate, lease contract, identity documents of managers and shareholders, board resolution appointing the fiscal representative, and a notarized power of attorney; (3) receiving the unified Tax Card (TIN) normally within 10 to 30 business days and the opening of a separate VAT registration file; (4) for non-resident suppliers of digitally supplied services consumed in Egypt, mandatory VAT registration is performed through an appointed Egyptian tax representative. The same TIN is used for income tax, employer payroll, VAT, customs, and stamp tax purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — an Egypt-resident LLC is a separate taxable entity subject to corporate income tax at 22.5% on worldwide income with a foreign tax credit mechanism; LLCs are not pass-through vehicles; branches of non-resident companies are taxed only on Egypt-source income; no general Tax_Exempt_Zone classification applies to standard LLCs outside special economic zones.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egyptian law provides no check-the-box election. Available statutory elections include: (a) fiscal unity/consolidated tax filing for resident companies with at least 95% common ownership; (b) simplified cash-basis accounting for qualifying small enterprises; (c) investment incentive and Special Economic Zone elections under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; (d) foreign tax credit election for repatriated foreign profits; (e) no domestic hybrid-mismatch election — Egypt applies OECD BEPS-aligned CFC, transfer pricing, and treaty limitation-on-benefits rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — Law No. 67 of 2016 (replacing Sales Tax Law No. 11 of 1991), administered by the ETA VAT Department
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual value of taxable supplies — mandatory VAT registration for resident suppliers; non-resident providers of electronically supplied services (including AI video synthesis and virtual avatar SaaS) are registrable where services are consumed in Egypt even below the threshold, through an appointed fiscal representative
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: ETA mandates real-time e-invoicing clearance: invoices must be transmitted in XML/JSON under the ETA Invoice Data Protocol through the ETA Data Exchange API (P2P integration), validated in real time, and stamped with a 'Code64' QR code before issuance; non-compliant issuers are barred from VAT deduction and subject to fines; B2C e-receipts are being phased in on the same clearance API.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to (a) goods physically exported from Egypt outside the customs territory and (b) services performed in Egypt but supplied to and consumed by non-residents abroad, including exported software licenses, AI-generated video content, and SaaS/virtual avatar subscription services, provided the supplier holds a valid VAT registration, issues an ETA-cleared e-invoice at 0%, and retains documented proof of non-resident supply, actual offshore consumption, and receipt of payment in convertible foreign currency; services ancillary to exported goods also qualify.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ECS — Export Customs Statement) submitted through the Egyptian Customs NAFEZA portal for any goods or software-on-media movement

Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export (for media or file-based delivery; for pure cloud SaaS, the export is evidenced instead by server and consumption logs demonstrating non-resident usage)
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or bank FX credit advice issued by a licensed Egyptian bank confirming receipt from the non-resident customer in convertible currency
Executed export sales or subscription contract and commercial correspondence with the non-resident party
ETA-cleared e-invoice (Code64) showing the zero-rate indicator and the customer master file (CMF) code of the buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA performs retrospective audits of export zero-rating and refund claims; failure to repatriate export proceeds within the 180-day window, submission of fraudulent documents, or diversion of digital services to domestic consumption triggers VAT reassessment at 14% on the full consideration, monthly delay surcharges, fines ranging from EGP 50,000 up to EGP 5 million, and/or imprisonment under Articles 77 to 79 of VAT Law No. 67 of 2016, together with full clawback of input VAT credits claimed on export-related purchases; zero-rating is withdrawn retroactively for all uncovered periods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) under Law No. 194 of 2020; foreign-exchange and anti-money-laundering supervision is executed jointly with the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU), while investment registration is administered by the General Authority for Investment (GAFI).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian pound (EGP) is convertible under a liberalised managed float maintained since March 2024; current-account convertibility (software licensing, SaaS exports, remittance of services proceeds) is permitted through CBE-licensed banks against documented underlying transactions, although episodic USD liquidity constraints and bank-level queuing may affect execution speed. Capital-account operations (FDI equity injection, inter-company borrowing, dividend and profit repatriation) require bank intermediation, GAFI/CBE registration of the investment, audited financials, tax clearance, and statutory proofs of after-tax distributable profits; there are no blanket exchange controls prohibiting remittance, but every transfer must be justified by a purpose code and a complete documentary file.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Software/SaaS export revenues qualify as services exports and must be repatriated in full value directly to a CBE-licensed account in Egypt; the CBE requires credit within a target collection period of 30 calendar days from the invoice/payment date, with a maximum permissible extension of a further 30 days on documented justification. The mandatory conversion (surrender) ratio is currently 0% in the liberalised regime: proceeds may be retained in foreign currency or converted freely in the interbank market, but they must enter the Egyptian banking system and cannot be warehoused indefinitely in offshore PSP or EMI accounts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency Operational Account (EGP/USD/EUR) + Capital Escrow Account
Multi-currency Operational Account (EGP/USD/EUR) with corporate cash-management e-banking
Operational Account plus Designated Foreign-Currency Account; Capital Escrow Account on request
Operational Account (EGP) and USD Receivables Sub-Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low — offshore EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) hold no CBE licence, cannot maintain EGP balances, and cannot lawfully act as the final receiving and warehousing vehicle for Egyptian services export proceeds; they are acceptable only as ancillary collection/payout conduits with full and timely repatriation to a CBE-licensed bank within the statutory window. Onshore licensed payment providers (Fawry, Paymob, e-finance) are the structurally compliant alternative for merchant acquiring and settle directly into the LLC's Egyptian account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Face-to-face attendance is effectively mandatory: Egyptian banks apply the FATF-aligned CBE AML rulebook (Law No. 80 of 2002 as amended), requiring authorised signatories and at least one UBO/board representative to appear physically for biometric verification and account-mandate signature. Foreign directors may satisfy the requirement by executing a notarised, apostilled/consular-legalised power of attorney appointing an Egyptian-resident representative or general manager who attends the branch interview in person; remote video-KYC is treated only as a supplementary control, not a substitute.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incomplete beneficial-ownership chain where shareholders sit behind multiple foreign holding vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI company-file extract, commercial register certificate, constitution (MOA/AOA) with certified Arabic translation, UBO register extracts of each holding entity, FATCA/CRS self-certifications (W-8/W-9 equivalents), passports of natural-person UBOs, and board resolution confirming the ownership cascade.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unproven source of funds for the inbound capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six-month source bank statements of the subscribing shareholder/parent, audited financial statements or interim management accounts, share subscription agreement, share-capital/escrow release instruction to the CBE-licensed bank, GAFI investment registration certificate, and a Law 80/2002 source-of-funds declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border SaaS collections lacking a comprehensible onboarding paper trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant agreements and payout/disbursement statements from Stripe/Paddle, sample customer contracts and invoices, monthly revenue and refund reports, ISIC 6201 business-activity certificate, software-export registration documentation, and CBE services-export classification (software licensing) confirmation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Exposure to higher-risk counterparties or jurisdictions in the shareholder/revenue chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due-diligence file: sanctions and PEP screening results, jurisdiction risk assessment, source-of-wealth memoranda, negative-media review, and legal opinion confirming no nexus to laundered proceeds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Absence of local biometric attendance by foreign statutory officers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised power of attorney apostilled/consular-legalised with Ministry of Foreign Affairs Arabic translation, original board resolution naming signatories, appointment contract of the Egyptian-resident general manager/representative, and physical attendance for biometric capture by the local representative.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder remits by SWIFT MT103 with Category Purpose Code 111/112 (investment, transfer to company account) and narrative 'FDI equity contribution / paid-in share capital' into the CBE-licensed bank's nostro; the bank books the receipt to the LLC's capital escrow (settlement) account, issues an advice of receipt for GAFI/CBE investment registration, and releases funds to the operating account only after the Commercial Registry reflects the shareholding or capital increase. Documentary verification comprises the GAFI incorporation certificate, board resolution on share issuance, UBO declarations, source-of-funds evidence, and the audited subscription agreement; no CBE prior approval is required for ordinary capital subscriptions, but the bank must attribute the inflow to the correct balance-of-payments direct-investment category.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For SaaS operations, outbound liquidity settles via SWIFT MT103 (Category Purpose Code 104 for services, 101 for trade payments, 112 for inter-company advances) through the corporate bank after documentary checks (service agreement, invoice, tax/withholding confirmation); large one-off software or infrastructure purchases may use sight Commercial LCs, but the standard SaaS practice is clean payments with verified invoices. Merchant-collected revenues from Stripe/Paddle (or onshore PSPs Fawry/Paymob) are swept to the LLC's Egyptian USD/EGP account by SWIFT within the 30-day repatriation window, and foreign-currency outflows (cloud, contractors, royalties, dividends) are purchased through the interbank market with hedging support from the same relationship bank.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts (fixed-date and window) with CBE-licensed banks against documented service-export receivables and payables
FX swaps (spot/forward combination) for working-capital currency conversion timing
Plain-vanilla foreign exchange options on a hedge-only basis where the bank offers the product
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) routed through licensed intermediary banks strictly against underlying EGP exposure, with speculation prohibited
Cross-currency swaps for long-term USD funding matched to hard-currency service revenues

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements (balance sheet, profit and loss, notes, and audit report) prepared under Egyptian Accounting Standards
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) via the unified corporate tax filing portal; also filed with GAFI/Commercial Registry when required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the close of the fiscal year (30 April for a calendar-year taxpayer); fiscal-year companies due on the corresponding fourth-month anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties under Egyptian income tax law; monthly surcharge on assessed tax; non-acceptance of unaudited accounts; continued failure triggers enforced collection and administrative removal from the Commercial Registry

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (CIT) with all schedules and tax computation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within four months after the end of the taxable year; calendar-year LLCs must file by 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of up to 1% per month on the tax due; additional administrative fines; tax clearance certificate suspended; repeated non-compliance allows compulsory collection and strike-off from the commercial register

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary general assembly meeting minutes approving the annual accounts, auditor's report, and discharge of managers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Retained in the statutory minute book and made available to the Commercial Registry, GAFI, and the Egyptian Tax Authority upon inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Held and minuted within six months after the end of each fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Managers/directors may be fined under companies law for failure to convene the annual assembly; accounts may be treated as unaudited/unapproved; governance default can lead to registry compliance red-flag

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registry renewal/update declaration confirming company name, registered office, managers, quota-holders, and shareholding changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) and the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of the annual general assembly or promptly upon any registry-data change; renewal on the anniversary of initial commercial registration (subject to registrar calendar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal fines under the Commercial Registry Law; registry record marked suspended; continued default leads to delisting from the Commercial Registry and administrative strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for every Egyptian LLC with commercial registration: annual financial statements must be audited by a certified public accountant registered in Egypt. There is no statutory turnover, capital, or employee threshold for LLCs engaged in software/AI service activities; even a dormant LLC must produce an auditor's report or show a formal exemption.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) as issued under Egyptian income tax law and the Companies Law; EAS are materially converged with IFRS. Financial statements may also need to be aligned for ETA tax-form mapping.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: LLCs are required to keep an up-to-date quota-holder register and to record every transfer of quotas or change in beneficial ownership within 15 days of the transaction. At the annual general assembly, managers must confirm the ledger of quota-holders and the UBO information against AML requirements under Egypt's Anti-Money Laundering Law. No separate Egyptian UBO annual return is due, but GAFI, ETA, or the Financial Intelligence Unit may demand an updated beneficial-owner confirmation in the ordinary course; any annual compliance event is evidenced by an assembly resolution and updated statutory register.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Statutory General Assemblies
Register of Attendance of General Assemblies

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 – 1,200 per year (registered office and local corporate agent in Cairo/Alexandria)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – 5,500 per year for a typical AI/software LLC with audited accounts and moderate transaction volumes

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday for software service companies. Eligible enterprises in qualifying industrial zones or under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 may obtain an investment tax credit of up to 30–50% of the paid-in capital cost, subject to minimum operational and employment thresholds. AI video generation SaaS activities are typically taxed at the headline rate without sector-specific deductions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Egyptian Tax Return Form No. 19 (Corporate Income Tax) filed electronically via the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-Tax portal at https://www.incometax.gov.eg or https://www.eta.gov.eg.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four calendar months from the end of the fiscal year. For a December 31 year-end, the return must be filed no later than April 30 of the following year. Extension of time to file is not automatically granted; a formal application must be submitted to the ETA prior to the deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue from AIGC video synthesis platform subscriptions, license fees, and incidental technology services derived from both Egyptian and export sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident LLCs with a fixed place of business in Egypt that are taxed on a net basis must report only Egyptian-sourced gross revenue attributable to the permanent establishment; export revenue may be excluded if no Egyptian nexus.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 – Cost of Sales and Direct Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cloud computing costs, AI model licensing, bandwidth, depreciation of computer equipment, staff salaries, and direct production costs associated with avatar generation and video rendering.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses directly incurred for the Egyptian PE are deductible; home office and shared service charges must be supported by Egyptian transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 – Operating Expenses and Administrative Charges
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing, legal, accounting, premises, software development, and general administrative costs not capitalized.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Head office general administrative expenses may be allocated only under a cost-sharing agreement compliant with Egypt TP rules; deductions are denied if no beneficial service evidence exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net profit before tax after adding disallowed expenses and deducting any investment incentives or tax credits claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident should compute Egyptian net profit strictly under Egyptian GAAP; transfer pricing adjustments are to be reflected in this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 – Corporate Income Tax Due at 22.5%
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computed by applying the 22.5% headline rate to the adjusted taxable income amount, before any foreign tax credit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credit limits apply only where a DTA exists; for treaty relief, the relevant effective tax certificate must be attached.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 – WHT on Payment of Dividends by the LLC
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory 10% withholding tax levied on dividend distributions to shareholders; this box records the amount withheld and payable to the ETA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC must withhold and remit the 10% dividend WHT on distributions to non-resident shareholders unless a treaty reduction is substantiated with a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties accrue at 2% of the assessed tax due for each complete month of delay, capped at 50% of the tax. In addition, a fixed fine of EGP 2,000 to EGP 5,000 is imposed for failure to file the return. Failure to file for 12 months or more may result in an administrative assessment and criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief on dividend distributions, the non-resident shareholder must deliver an original or certified copy of the Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by its home tax authority to the ELLC before the dividend payment date. The TRC must evidence beneficial ownership and residence. The LLC then applies the reduced treaty rate, generally 5–10% for dividends, at source. The shareholder must also submit a completed Form establishing beneficial ownership (as requested by the ETA) within 30 days from the payment. Retroactive refund claims are possible via an ETA refund application within five years from the end of the tax year, but interest is not paid on refunds.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates are 20% for royalties and 20% for interest paid to non-residents. Under applicable DTAs, rates may be reduced to 10–15% for royalties and 10–15% for interest, subject to TRC and beneficial ownership conditions. The AI avatar software license fees and subscription income are generally classified as royalties if payment is for the use of copyrighted software; fees for cloud-hosted subscription services may be treated as business profits under many DTAs and not subject to WHT if no PE exists.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatorily required when the aggregate value of controlled transactions with related parties exceeds EGP 8 million per fiscal year. Master File is required when the global group consolidated revenue exceeds EGP 200 million and the group meets the OECD CbCR threshold equivalent, regardless of Egyptian transaction value.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not have a separate Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) code akin to UAE. However, the ETA applies a general anti-abuse rule and substance-over-form doctrine under Law 91/2005. Controlled transactions and corporate vehicles must demonstrate real management and activities in Egypt; shell or conduit arrangements that artificially shift profits are disregarded and reconstructed under the arm's length principle. Beneficial ownership is required for all treaty relief claims.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Willful Falsification of Corporate Income Tax Return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting a corporate tax return with fabricated revenue figures, inflating deductible expenses, destroying accounting records, or knowingly misdeclaring AI platform revenue and subscription income to reduce taxable profits in Egypt. Also includes issuing false invoices for SaaS royalties to shift profits to tax havens.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 133 and related provisions of Law No. 91 of 2005, tax evasion is punishable by imprisonment of not less than 3 years and not more than 5 years, plus a fine of EGP 10,000 to EGP 50,000. The unpaid tax is immediately collectible with prejudgment interest. The ETA may additionally impose an administrative penalty equal to the evaded tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns or participate in the evasion are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid corporate tax. The corporate veil is pierced under fraud or abuse of law principles, exposing personal bank accounts, and travel bans may be issued under criminal proceedings. Imprisonment is imposed directly on the responsible director or manager, not merely on the corporate entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Artificial Profit Shifting with No Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a nominal LLC that avails of a tax treaty or Egyptian incentives while all real decisions, servers, personnel, and AI video-generation operations are managed from another jurisdiction; also using circular intercompany licenses to strip profits without genuine research and development activity in Egypt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Egyptian tax law and judicial doctrine disallow artificial arrangements. The ETA may recharacterize the transactions, impose 22.5% corporate tax on the reattributed income, assess a 20% annual late-payment penalty, and impose a civil fine of up to EGP 20,000. For treaty-shopping arrangements, the ETA may deny all DTA benefits and apply the statutory 20% royalty and 20% interest WHT, rather than the reduced treaty rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a shell LLC that uses the vehicle to commit tax fraud face piercing of the corporate veil. They are jointly liable for the entire tax shortfall and fines. Civil trademark or fraud suits can be brought by commercial counterparties; the ETA can request travel bans against directors who attempt to leave Egypt while a criminal charge is pending; imprisonment follows criminal conviction for fraudulent tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) / Terrorist Financing Violations in Revenue Transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting large volume of digital sales proceeds from AI avatar video generation services without performing customer due diligence, failing to file suspicious activity reports (SARs) with the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (MLTFU), or facilitating anonymous prepaid crypto-card or shell-company payments while aware of fraudulent origin.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Egyptian Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002 (as amended), entities must implement robust KYC procedures. Penalties for AML violations include a fine ranging from EGP 5,000 to EGP 10,000,000 depending on extent, and license suspension or withdrawal of the payment intermediary approval (Stripe/Paddle). Knowingly engaging in money laundering is punishable by imprisonment up to 15 years and a fine equal to between 300% and 500% of the laundered amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who intentionally or recklessly bypass the internal AML controls bear personal criminal liability. They may be imprisoned for up to 10 years for aiding money laundering. Travel bans and seizure of personal assets are ordered upon initiation of the criminal case. The corporate veil is pierced for fraud and irregularity, and officers are not indemnified by the company's articles of association.
